lines.text: Lightning is hotter than the Sun.
Not a little hotter. And that heat makes a sound you know.
The surface of the Sun is about five thousand five hundred degrees Celsius.

lines.text: A lightning bolt can heat the air to about thirty thousand.

lines.text: That's about five times hotter than the Sun's surface.

lines.text: The air heats up so fast, it bursts outward.
